data.description: I'm a Software Engineer at Oracle Hospitality, where I build production features for OPERA Cloud, a platform used by 40K+ hotels globally. Across 3.5+ years of full-time experience, I've worked on microservices, Java-based backend systems, React + TypeScript interfaces, SQL optimization, and AI-driven automation with Python and LLM workflows. I enjoy owning complex product problems end-to-end and shipping solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and user-focused.
